ValidationRule.description: mark Consumer Privacy Act Category required if CCPA Inquiry box is checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , NSP_Consumer_Privacy_Inquiry__c , ISPICKVAL( NSP_Consumer_Privacy_Act_Category__c , "" ) )
